text: dsh-gsap 是面向 DSH Desktop 的 GSAP 技能插件，通过 DSH 的 skills 注册服务把随包提供的八个技能加入技能库，默认全部启用，也可在配置中选择子集。技能涵盖 GSAP 核心补间与缓动、时间线编排、ScrollTrigger 滚动动画、React 与 Vue/Svelte 集成、官方插件、工具函数及性能优化建议。安装并重启 DSH 后，agent 可按需加载相应技能内容，用于编写或审阅网页动画。技能文档随包本地提供；代码未要求额外账号、密钥或运行时外部服务。

dsh-gsap registers eight bundled GSAP skills in DSH for animation, timelines, scrolling, frameworks, plugins, utilities, and performance. All are enabled by default; a subset can be selected. Install and restart DSH Desktop so agents can load the local guidance. No account or API key is required.
想让 DSH 能回答 GSAP 补间动画和缓动怎么写。
需要设计一组按顺序播放的网页动画，该找什么帮助？
帮我实现随页面滚动触发、固定区块或视差效果。
React 组件卸载后动画没有清理，该怎么处理？
让 DSH 帮我处理 Vue 或 Svelte 组件里的动画生命周期。
想找动画插件的用法，比如拖拽、形变或滚动到元素。
Help me optimize browser animations to avoid jank and layout thrashing.
I need reusable helpers for clamping, mapping, snapping, or randomizing animation values.
dsh-gsap 的功能「注册 GSAP 技能」：将包内技能的名称、说明和正文注册到 DSH skills 服务。插件加载时默认注册八项，也可通过 skills 配置选择子集；输入为技能文件，产出为可供 agent 加载的技能。
dsh-gsap 的功能「动画编排与滚动效果指导」：提供 GSAP 时间线和 ScrollTrigger 技能，帮助组织连续动画、滚动触发、固定区块与 scrub 效果。agent 加载相应技能后获得这些实现主题的说明。
dsh-gsap 的功能「框架动画建议」：提供 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架相关 GSAP 技能，涵盖 useGSAP、组件生命周期和卸载清理。用户在 DSH 中询问框架动画时，由 agent 加载相应技能并据此回答。

dsh-gsap README · dsh-gsap：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A single-package [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that registers the eight official [GSAP AI skills](https://github.com/greensock/gsap-skills).

Install, restart, done. No toggle button, no browser half, no RPC, no state file, no configuration, account or API key.

dsh-gsap README · Install：From the plugin market (Settings → Plugins), or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-gsap
```

Installing the prebuilt tarball from the GitHub release (no npm account or build step needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add https://github.com/eryi-lab/dsh-gsap/releases/latest/download/dsh-gsap.tgz
```

Installing from source instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:eryi-lab/dsh-gsap
```
dsh-gsap README · Install：Restart DSH Desktop afterwards — a bundle is read at boot and cannot be hot-loaded.

dsh-gsap README · What it registers：| Skill | Covers |
|---|---|
| `gsap-core` | Core API: `gsap.to()/from()/fromTo()`, easing, duration, stagger, defaults, `matchMedia()` |
| `gsap-timeline` | Timelines: labels, nesting, position parameter |
| `gsap-scrolltrigger` | Scroll-driven animation: ScrollTrigger, scrub, pin, refresh |
| `gsap-react` | React: `useGSAP()`, cleanup, SSR |
| `gsap-frameworks` | Vue / Svelte / Nuxt and other framework integration |
| `gsap-plugins` | Official plugins: SplitText, MorphSVG, Flip, Draggable and more |
| `gsap-utils` | `gsap.utils`: clamp, mapRange, random, snap, toArray |
| `gsap-performance` | Performance: prefer transforms, avoid layout thrashing, will-change, batching |

dsh-gsap README · What it registers：Skill bodies ship inside the package under `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, taken from
`greensock/gsap-skills` (MIT — see `LICENSE.gsap-skills`). Registration reads only the
frontmatter; the body is read when an agent actually loads that skill.

dsh-gsap README · Optional configuration：All eight skills are registered by default. To register a subset, override the row by id in
your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: gsap
  config:
    skills: [gsap-core, gsap-scrolltrigger]
```

dsh-gsap README · Design notes：- **One dependency only**: the cordis `skills` service (`inject: ['skills']`). It registers no
  tools, does not touch the composer, and adds nothing to the session token baseline.
- **A missing registration surface is an error**: without the skills registry the plugin throws
  instead of silently skipping, because "installed but empty" is harder to diagnose than a
  failed boot.
- **One broken skill does not take the host down**: a damaged `SKILL.md` is warned about and
  skipped. All eight failing throws, because that indicates an environment problem rather than
  a file problem.
dsh-gsap README · License：MIT for this plugin. The bundled skill documents are MIT, from greensock/gsap-skills.
